# zhi2-web-admin
zhi2-web-admin (苏住房G) is the 苏住房 admin web frontend, led by the 苏住房 frontend project Lead, who decides task assignment and implementation plans and is responsible for development and visual acceptance.

## Project Info
- Repo root D:/repository/苏住房G on Windows (D: drive).
- Navbar component is src/layout/components/Navbar.vue; the visual regression case is e2e/home-v2/navbar-visual.spec.mjs.
- Full-image E2E visual acceptance threshold is 99.5% similarity.
- Owned by the 苏住房 frontend project Lead, whose 禅道 account is tiany.
- Related norm: real `meta.icon` takes priority over the title fallback when adjusting visual candidates.

## Worktree and Commits
- Commits must be made in an isolated worktree so the main workspace and other worktrees keep their retained changes.
- Baseline build and follow-up verification run at the original repo root with the same installed dependencies.
- An isolated worktree's dependency layout may not hit the project Vite, so the baseline build can exit within a second; this is not a source error.
- Vite treats the parent repo directory as `env` and `dist` root, so an isolated worktree must keep the full parent repo structure to avoid reading the wrong env or writing the wrong output directory.
- A build log silent for 120 seconds may still be running and can finish normally, so it should not be rerun.

## Build and Staging
- Candidate and formal builds always set an absolute staging `outDir`; the formal `dist` is replaced only after the staging full E2E and version check pass, and the backup is restored on failure or when test markers are scanned.
- A test-mode build (`npm test`) is run in the background through the watchdog, keeping state and logs in a temp dir instead of the project dir.
- E2E runs through a one-shot watchdog wrapper that disables and then re-enables the original config via the UI helper in `finally`, instead of editing the enabled config file.
- The candidate site's HTTP response must match the worktree build; this was confirmed consistent on 2026-11-14.
- E2E acceptance must cover empty permissions, bidirectional scrolling, active-item visibility and a test-marker scan; `vite.config.js` main-checkout builds output to the repo-root `dist`, which matches the local nginx site.

## Acceptance and Tasks
- Task 2468 (Navbar visual restyle) details are kept in the task2468_navbar_visual entity.
- Bug 6899 (big-screen live-report hover card) is still in real-machine verification.
- On 2026-11-24 the delivery-chain end flow is real-machine verification → screenshot into the session → user confirmation → commit and Zentao writeback → cleanup; work is at hop 2 with code changes done, proceeding on the unfinished items in section 4 of the handoff doc.
- The 2026-11-24 start snapshot matches the handoff: parent repo dirty=5 and submodule dirty=7 are unrelated to this task and must not be touched; the `screen-motion` worktree is also not touched.
- The local site runs on port 8101; its login page has a graphic captcha (on 2026-11-24 an arithmetic `6 * 9 = 54`), so use agent-browser to establish a session, then fill account, password and captcha to log in.
